name: mastersoft
description: Shared Mastersoft Claude Code tooling: hooks, agents, skills, statusline

push_protected_branches.title: Protected branches
push_protected_branches.description: Comma-separated branches whose pushes ask for confirmation: name/* matches a prefix, * matches every branch. Leave empty for the org list in ORG_RULES.md.

quiet.title: Quiet mode
quiet.description: 1 mutes the plugin's injected rules and lint signals, lints mutes the lint signals only, tier3 mutes the per-prompt reminder only. Leave empty to keep everything on.

org_rules.title: Org rules
org_rules.description: all injects every tier of the org rules, session skips the per-prompt tier, off injects none. Leave empty for all.
